description: Objects merged together creating hybrid structures

bboxes.caption: Tree trunk merges seamlessly with building wall - wooden bark texture blends directly into concrete creating impossible hybrid structure
Person's arm fuses with bicycle handlebar - skin and metal merge together with no clear boundary creating ambiguous hybrid appendage

explanation: Fusion artifacts result from the combination of objects where their boundaries merge into ambiguous, hybrid parts. This example shows a tree merging with a building and a person's arm fusing with bicycle parts, creating visually incoherent regions.
